definitions.query_target: area-averaged GT at each feature resolution
definitions.groups: foreground: occupancy >= 0.5; background: occupancy < 0.5; mixed: 0 < occupancy < 1
definitions.guide: image-derived guide sigmoid at the query position
definitions.nominal_change_mass: attention summed over even-indexed nominal change prototypes, averaged over heads
definitions.retrieved_gt_occupancy: same attention applied to same-weight pooled GT, averaged over heads
definitions.prototype_nominal_agreement: actual change occupancy for change tokens; 1 - occupancy for background tokens
definitions.context_off: zero global gamma only; local branch remains enabled
definitions.label_use: GT enters post-forward analysis only, never model forward
definitions.interpretation: frozen-weight val diagnostics; not retrained ablations
